name: Palomares del Campo (Spain)
description: Red field with a white Scandinavian cross, charged at the crossing with the crowned municipal arms of Palomares del Campo (a star and doves on green).
history: Municipal flag of Palomares del Campo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Palomares del Campo arms — star and doves on green
